ptBR.note: Brazil writes nós falamos in the perfeito too (Portugal: falámos), and says dirigir where Portugal says conduzir.

tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B takes the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “O que é que fizeste no fim de semana?” The verb tile is the infinitive: you choose the form.

B hears the question and builds the answer with the perfeito. Some verbs are regular (comer, comeu), others are irregular and must be learnt: fazer, fiz, fez; ter, tive, teve; dizer, disse. Ser and ir share one form: fui, foi. Check the forms in the reference list of irregular verbs. A tile in brackets, like (eu), says who; it is not written.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Finally: swap cards and do it all again, faster.
